name: Feel Energy | 10mg Seltzer | Mango Passionfruit
description: Tropical flavor meets functional refreshment in our Mango Passionfruit infusion. With a sunny blend of mango and tangy passionfruit, plus 10mg THC and 30mg green tea caffeine, it’s made to energize your body and mellow your mind. Just 20 calories per 12oz can, naturally sweetened with agave, and crafted to be non-GMO, vegan, and gluten-free—this is a better-for-you beverage that tastes like paradise.
